AgentSession run orchestration [agent-session.ts]
|
|-- prompt(text, options)
|   |-- Extension command may handle input before _preparePrompt()
|   |-- Input hooks -> skill/template expansion
|   |-- Streaming: explicit steer/followUp policy queues; otherwise throws
|   `-- Idle: validate model/auth -> _startRun()
|-- _prepareRun()
|   |-- Check compaction -> before_agent_start hooks -> normalize images
|   `-- Prompt options + tool loadout -> starting messages/system patch
|-- Agent.prompt(messages) / Agent.continue()
|   `-- -> runAgentLoop()/runAgentLoopContinue() [agent-loop.ts]
|       |-- prepareRequest hook -> canonical projection and model routing
|       |-- streamAssistantResponse()
|       |   `-- transformContext -> convertToLlm -> configured stream function
|       |-- Assistant tool calls -> executeToolCalls()
|       |   `-- Validate -> beforeToolCall -> execute(signal, update) -> afterToolCall
|       |-- Tool results + steering -> another assistant turn
|       |-- Follow-ups drain when the loop would otherwise stop
|       `-- Events -> Agent state + AgentSession event handler
|-- _handlePostAgentRun()
|   |-- Retryable error / overflow compaction -> Agent.continue()
|   `-- Queues added by agent_end handlers may restart execution
|-- Before-settle boundary handlers may request continuation
|   `-- Queues and recovery finish -> agent_settled (later than agent_end)
`-- abort()
    `-- Cancel Agent and recovery work -> await waitForIdle()
